name: slide_convert
title: Convert Slidev to PPTX
description: Converts a Slidev project to PPTX. The duration is proportional to the number of slides (just under 30 seconds for 55 slides).

project_dir.description: Absolute path of the Slidev project directory. Relative paths are not accepted. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

out_path.description: Absolute path of the output .pptx. If omitted, <project_dir>/pptx/<title of slides.md | basename>.pptx. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

spacing_json_path.description: Absolute path of the letter-spacing JSON. If omitted, staging/slides/letter-spacing.json is auto-detected. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

href_json_path.description: Absolute path of the hyperlink JSON. If omitted, staging/slides/href-map.json is auto-detected. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

transition_duration_ms.description: Slide transition duration, as a positive integer in milliseconds (default: 500)

morph_option.description: Granularity of the morph transition. Only meaningful when transition_type=morph

cache.description: Whether to read the diff cache. Even with false, the cache is rebuilt when the conversion completes

event.description: slide.convert.done on success; slide.convert.error, runtime-dependencies.unavailable or chromium.unavailable on failure (omitted when a path argument is rejected)

input.description: Absolute path of the converted Slidev project (success only)

output.description: Absolute path of the written .pptx (success only)

durationMs.description: Time the conversion took in milliseconds (success only)

selector.description: CSS selector of the element (element level only)

errors.description: Conversion errors per slide or element (empty when none). Element-level errors do not fail the call. Returned on success and on slide.convert.error

animationTimingRemovedSlides.description: Number of slides whose p:timing from decorative CSS animations was removed (success only)

timings.description: Time spent per stage in milliseconds (success only, when measured)

phases.description: Time per phase in milliseconds (converted steps only)

singlePass.description: Timing of the single-pass route (only when it was tried)

cache.description: Diff cache result (success only, when the cache was handled)

enabled.description: Whether the diff cache was used

invalidated.description: How existing cache entries were invalidated

expectedAt.description: Where the missing runtime dependencies or Playwright Chromium are expected (failure only, kind runtime-dependencies-not-installed / chromium-not-installed / chromium-install-failed)

invalidPaths.description: Rejected path arguments as <parameter>=<value> (failure only, kind invalid-path)

convertedPaths.description: Windows-style path arguments converted before the rejection, keyed by parameter name (failure only, kind invalid-path; omitted when nothing was converted)

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of the command or child process (failure only). Over 64KB, the end is kept and the first line notes the truncation

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run (omitted when there are none). Beyond 100 warnings or 64KB, the last item tells how many were omitted
